This Thanksgiving, Marni Charnow, a 32-year-old tech consultant, drove 21 hours to her family’s home in Southern Florida to celebrate Thanksgiving. She started from her house in Birmingham, Michigan, with her cats in the back seat, all to save on the now-astronomical cost of airfare for herself and her pets.
